# Modding

Modifying the interface and resources of phone firmware.

## Programs

- **[Siemens CE](./siemens-ce.md)**<br/>
  Search for and edit built-in fonts in Siemens phone FullFlash images.
- **[ST55 BG Maker](./st55-bg-maker.md)**<br/>
  Prepare background images and logos for Siemens ST55.
- **[STRes](./stres.md)**<br/>
